python3 << 'EOF'
data = open('/app/main.db-wal.bak','rb').read()
import struct
# WAL header is 32 bytes
print("Size:", len(data))
print("Header bytes:", data[:32].hex())
magic, version, pgsz, ckpt, s1, s2, c1, c2 = struct.unpack('>8I', data[:32])
print(f"magic={magic:#x} version={version} pgsz={pgsz} ckpt={ckpt} salt1={s1:#x} salt2={s2:#x} cksum=({c1:#x},{c2:#x})")
# frame count
frames = (len(data)-32) // (24+pgsz)
print("frames:", frames)
# Check XOR patterns: valid magic
print("XOR with 0x377f0682:", hex(magic ^ 0x377f0682))
print("XOR with 0x377f0683:", hex(magic ^ 0x377f0683))
# maybe XOR with key 0x00000001? 
# check header salt consistency
print("salt1==0?", s1==0, "salt2==0?", s2==0)
EOF

python3 << 'EOF'
data = open('/app/main.db-wal.bak','rb').read()
fixed = bytes(b ^ 0x42 for b in data)
open('/app/wal_fixed.wal','wb').write(fixed)
import struct
h = struct.unpack('>8I', fixed[:32])
print(f"magic={h[0]:#x} version={h[1]} pgsz={h[2]} ckpt={h[3]} salt1={h[4]:#x} salt2={h[5]:#x} cksum=({h[6]:#x},{h[7]:#x})")
print("frames:", (len(fixed)-32)//(24+h[2]))
for i in range((len(fixed)-32)//(24+h[2])):
    off = 32 + i*(24+h[2])
    pgno, dbsize, fs1, fs2, c1, c2 = struct.unpack('>6I', fixed[off:off+24])
    print(f"frame {i}: pgno={pgno} dbsize={dbsize} salt1={fs1:#x} salt2={fs2:#x} cksum=({c1:#x},{c2:#x})")
EOF
